body: Release v0.1.2 and cli/v0.1.3 (2026-10-14, commits 17635c9 and ba976d8): the fix batch from FIX-REPORT-2. Library: Compose-style expansion for self-references, cycles and single-quoted values; Set stores $ literally and round-trips; SaveGuard/EntryObserver get copies; commented colon prose is a comment; minimum Go 1.22. CLI requires library v0.1.2: failures on stderr, one --json envelope per run, per-plugin empty-list hint, embedded --version, WithProgramName. Patch bumps by owner decision (the brief had proposed v0.2.0, never tagged). CHANGELOG headings disambiguate the two 0.1.2 releases as [0.1.2] (library) and [cli 0.1.2].
source_ref: tags v0.1.2 cli/v0.1.3; CHANGELOG.md 0.1.2 and cli 0.1.3
